dataset.name: KION
dataset.unit: Aggregated user-item pair with its last watch date
dataset.item_scope: Items observed in interactions; the metadata catalog has 15963 rows.

protocol.caveat: New held-out users on a previously studied calendar week; not a new temporal holdout.

costs.note: Original local fit and joint prediction timings; shared fits are reused. Controlled selective-feature and full warm-request timings are reported separately in results/serving_benchmark.json.

candidate_validation.scope: Exploratory validation-only retrieval coverage; no final-test access
candidate_validation.query_population: Saved warm users with at least one future-positive pair; raw cold-user queries outside snapshots excluded
candidate_validation.weighting: Equal mean of the two week-level metrics; total rows reported separately
candidate_validation.oracle: Perfect top-10 placement of captured positives; all truth positives retained in ideal denominator
candidate_validation.restriction: Only nested rank caps are reconstructed; no older V2 ALS=100 union can be inferred from V4 ALS=0

definitions.matrix: rows = frozen TRAIN anchor item latent vectors normalized to unit L2 norm
definitions.effective_rank_singular_entropy: exp(Shannon entropy of singular values / their sum)
definitions.effective_rank_energy_entropy: exp(Shannon entropy of squared singular values / their sum)
definitions.stable_rank: squared Frobenius norm / squared spectral norm
definitions.condition: finite condition covers nonzero singular spectrum only; not inversion of all latent coordinates
definitions.antipodal: negative cosine has opposite sign but near-absolute-one directions are linearly redundant

projection_energy.formula: residual = ||X - (X Q^T) Q||_F^2 / ||X||_F^2; Q orthonormal rows spanning frozen anchors
projection_energy.basis_construction: float64 SVD of normalized fixed TRAIN anchor rows; diagnostic only, no whitening or feature changes
projection_energy.zero_vector_policy: exclude nonfinite and norm<=1e-12 rows from both variants; raw zero rows would contribute zero energy; normalized zeros have no direction
projection_energy.pool_definition: active, finite, nonzero latent items; raw strict-prefix last30day row counts descending then raw item ID ascending; first frozen pool_size
projection_energy.no_quality_implication: Energy is unweighted item geometry, not recommendation quality; no user factors, labels, later prefixes, new anchors or selection changes.

anchor_geometry.scope: TRAIN-only fixed-anchor geometry diagnostic; no quality evaluation or selection
anchor_geometry.limitation: Sixteen anchor directions span at most sixteen of thirty-two latent dimensions; nonlinear downstream models do not make these projections an invertible full-vector encoding.

matched_catboost_comparisons.scope: Matched CatBoost family/params/seed; each side independently selects its tree prefix on development data. Not a best-family comparison or fixed-tree causal effect.

hardware.scope: Local measured research timings, not isolated service latency or a throughput SLA; CPU brand not recorded.

statistical_scope: Paired user-bootstrap, 2000 draws, descriptive marginal percentile intervals. No multiplicity correction, training-variance estimate, new-period inference or predeclared non-inferiority margin.
